rules.requiredForChoicesPresent: Every named choice must exist and consume this binding. Missing binding invalidates only those choices, not the entry.
rules.requiredForChoicesAbsent: Shared binding: missing invalidates the entry.
rules.unusedBinding: Do not resolve an unconsumed candidate binding. Remove copied template bindings with zero consumers.
rules.entryPredicateRestriction: Choice-only binding must not be required by an entry condition. Put existence checks on its consuming choices.
rules.missingEnumNote: Schema field missing remains invalidate. requiredForChoices scopes invalidation to the listed choices; without that list it invalidates the entry.
rules.unsupportedContext: A successful binding-scope check never removes unsupportedFilters.
